lede_pattern: If your Kensington front door opens onto a shared landing, someone other than you probably has a say in what goes on it.
Owners corporations control the hardware on common property, and in an agent-managed rental it is the managing agent who signs off a change, not the tenant.
Global Locksmiths has been fitting door hardware since 2002.
For a smart lock installation in Kensington, the quote names the exact lock and what preparing the door involves, so you have something specific to put to the committee or the agent.
Quotes are free and carry no obligation, on 1300 333 565.
